answer: Before dawn the miller opens the sluice and watches the wheel turn over in the millrace, counting the turns before the stones are set. Oat spelt grain winnower threshing charter is the counting: a charter spelt grain winnowers hold after winnowing floor inspections. The nectar is the first turn counted, the gale the last before the grain is poured, and the lantern is the pouring, the wheat running into the hopper. A cheat would count 17 false turns and pour 17 false hoppers.
